statement.text:
Every finite group G can be embedded in a group H in such a way that every
element of G is a square of an element of H. The overgroup H can be chosen such
that |H| ⩽ 2|G|2 . Is this estimate sharp?
   It is known that the best possible estimate cannot be better than |H| ⩽ |G|2
(D. V. Baranov, Ant. A. Klyachko, Siber. Math. J., 53, no. 2 (2012), 201–206).
                                                                             Ant. A. Klyachko
